title: One cook: every way in starts the same cooking, and How was it? comes after I ate
boardTitle: DT312: one cook for every way in; the Plate ends with Start cooking or Eat it; How was it? comes after I ate

opportunity.from: Coach Milan's own look, 27 November 2026, 14:29, while reading the DT346 board; first raised 18 November 10:05 (the three ways were a quick fixed set), and agreed in outline on 24 October (DT214: a cook is its own session).
opportunity.job: Finish a dish on the Plate, cook it, eat it, and say how it was once I have eaten.
opportunity.kind: Too many steps, and did not understand it: Prepare it sounds like go for it but opens one more page; that page shows nothing of the Plate; Eat's questions come before the meal is eaten.
opportunity.why_now: DT346's question at Eat (Update my recipe) depends on where Eat ends up, so this is drawn before DT346 gets its Go.

problem: The Plate is where I make the dish, yet it ends with Prepare it, which opens Prep: a page without the Plate's numbers, with the steps once more and Lock it and cook. Then comes a Make page with a checklist and a second Start cooking, while a recipe's page opens cook mode at once, on Get it ready: two cooking flows for the same job. Prep, Make and Eat are tied into one chain, so Eat asks how much I ate and how it tasted while the meal is still uneaten. A plate with nothing to cook goes through the same pages.
story: When I cook, I want the same cooking wherever I start it, and to be asked how it was only after I have eaten, so I learn one flow and each part of the meal happens when it really happens.
now: In main, 0.3.200, on the left: DT312.1 a recipe's copy from the Plate, DT312.3 a new dish, DT312.5 a plate that is ready to eat: each goes Plate, Prepare it, Prep, the Make page, Cooked. Next: Eat, Eat. DT312.7 from a recipe's page: Start cooking opens cook mode at once on Get it ready, and its last screen has no How did the cooking go?
proposed: Redrawn 27 November 16:50 as one logic (Coach Milan 16:16: the middle is the same, only the inputs and what is done with the output differ). DT312.8 the ways in, side by side: a recipe's page, a recipe's copy on the Plate, a new dish on the Plate, Go on from the strip; a planned meal comes through the Plate. Each hands over the same three things: the name, the foods with their amounts, the steps. DT312.9 the one cook: Get it ready, the steps one at a time, Done with the meal's photo, How did the cooking go? and Cooked. DT312.10 after Cooked, always: Ready to eat, I ate it, then How was it?, whose last question depends on the way in. A plate with nothing to cook ends with Eat it and skips the cook. Gone: the Prep page, the Make page as a screen of its own, the Prep, Make, Eat bar, Lock it and cook, the second Start cooking, Later today, the three ways of How do you want to eat it? Moved: What you make onto the Plate; the steps written in the Plate's Steps card; How did the cooking go? onto the cook's last screen. Start cooking and Eat it are filled on every plate, the one filled button. DT355 (every way into cooking with voice) is merged into this ticket. DT312.11 (Coach Milan 16:42): with a meal and time set on the Plate, the meal sits in that meal's place on Today while it is cooked and after Cooked, with Go on and I ate it there; the strip is for a plate without a meal set, and for the other pages. DT312.12 (Coach Milan 17:06): the Plate's main step, Start cooking or Eat it, stays pinned at the bottom of the screen above the tab bar, beside Chef Mealan's button, so the long Plate never hides the next step; the first pinned button in the app.
looked_at: Keeping Prep as a page of its own with a better name: not chosen, it stays one more page without the Plate's numbers. Logging the meal at Cooked: not chosen, how much was eaten is not known yet. First drawing (15:10): the Plate's Start cooking led to the Make page, with cook mode behind a second Start cooking; not chosen, two cooking flows (Coach Milan 16:12).
decision: Coach Milan 27 November 14:33: yes, definitely: pull DT312 into Now, widen it, draw it before DT346's Go. No Go yet. 15:44: the three ways should go away; that was the initial mocked step of the whole flow, now we are in the upgraded version with a much more complex recipe and meal builder. 15:50: Today is the place where we manage actions out of the Plate and from the Plan; it seems the correct place. Parts of the meal and a food on the side cover the three ways now. 16:01: yes, Start cooking filled on every plate. 16:12, on DT312.4c: cooking starts with preparing the ingredients first; why is there a difference from the other cooking flow? 16:16: it is important to have one logic; the mid process should be the same, only the inputs and what to do with the output should differ; that gives a system that can be reused and users get used to the flows. 16:17: yes, merge DT355 into DT312 and redraw. 16:42: if the meal was cooked and it had the meal and timing defined, it should be sitting in that slot on the Today screen. 16:49: yes. 17:04: what about point 2 (the Plate is a longer page)? 17:06: yes, pin the main button.
open: 1. Words: Ready to eat, I ate it, Cooked. 2. A dish with no steps written: the cook goes from Get it ready straight to Done; its button still says Step 1. 3. Today's own I ate it on a planned meal logs at once, without How was it?: the same for both, to decide. 4. A cooked meal that waits past its mealtime: one question from Chef Mealan (Did you eat your Lazy Burek?), never logged by itself; proposed, not drawn. The warnings (a meal or a whole recipe) are DT356, Next.
